ai_summary: This document discloses an inter-se transfer of 11.72% of Asian Hotels (East) Limited's equity shares as a gift from promoter Mrs. Ratna Saraf to promoter Mr. Arun Kumar Saraf. While this transaction significantly alters individual shareholdings within the promoter group, it results in no change to the group's overall aggregate ownership or control over the company. The transfer is exempt from open offer requirements under SEBI regulations for transactions between immediate relatives, indicating a routine internal restructuring without apparent red flags.
